races.verdict: RATTLEDELATCH has looked much improved over fences, travelling strongly when runner-up at this course in August before staying on late to finish fourth at Listowel a fortnight ago. He looks the one to beat. Doctor Confusion needs to brush up his jumping but shaped as though this longer trip is worth another go last time, while recent hurdle winner Moonlight Paradise is bred to make at least as good a chaser. RATTLEDELATCH (IRE) DOCTOR CONFUSION (FR) MOONLIGHT PARADISE (IRE)

races.verdict: DUCHESS ANNE has responded well to positive rides this year, going closer than she ever has when finishing a neck second at Punchestown 23 days ago. She could well prove tough to peg back returned to a shorter trip and earns the vote. Glamazon also ran well on her latest outing and is feared for a new yard, with Princess Chloe and last year's winner Queen Aethelflaed others to consider. DUCHESS ANNE (IRE) GLAMAZON (IRE) PRINCESS CHLOE (IRE)

races.verdict: GLEN ECHO is steadily going the right way in handicaps, enhancing his form further when posting a very good second at Roscommon 38 days ago. He looks to hold solid claims of going one place better, with Red Glory who has developed into a fairly useful hurdler since last seen on the Flat another key player. Felicity Smoak and Max Meridius also make each-way appeal. GLEN ECHO (IRE) RED GLORY (IRE) FELICITY SMOAK (IRE)

races.verdict: SAVANNAH SMILES has fallen to her last winning mark and looks ready to strike again judged on her eyecatching run here last week. Pedros Dream showed much more when second on his handicap bow at Windsor so is next best ahead of fellow 3-y-o Little Jaybee , who is building up a good record for her current yard. SAVANNAH SMILES (IRE) PEDROS DREAM LITTLE JAYBEE

races.verdict: Veteran EMPIRESTATEOFMIND arrives in fine fettle and goes unpenalised for his comfortable apprentice riders handicap success here under similar ground conditions so gets the vote. Stanage caught the eye when a fast-finishing third over C&D last time and seems sure to be on the premises, while Valentine Catcher is knocking on the door again and also commands plenty of respect. Cisco Disco and One Night Thunder also need factoring into this highly competitive sprint. EMPIRESTATEOFMIND (IRE) STANAGE VALENTINE CATCHER

races.verdict: Plenty look potentially well handicapped on the best of their soft-ground form, including TORALOU , who makes plenty of each-way appeal in a wide-open contest. Keats House is feared most if headgear continues to have the same effect. Interesting last-time-out winners Evelyn's Phoenix and Rory's Gold are possible pace angles in the race, along with 3-time C&D winner Penelope's Sister . TORALOU (IRE) KEATS HOUSE (IRE) EVELYN'S PHOENIX (FR)

races.verdict: None of the quintet can be ruled out but it's hard to side against AIGHEAR who scored in fine style here last week and can make light of a 4-lb penalty and follow up her victory in this 12 months ago.
